excluded_categories: Passwords, API keys, tokens, OAuth grants, cookies, browser sessions and credential stores
Raw Codex conversations, hidden reasoning, databases and machine configuration
Government tax identity document NPWP and identity/signature application forms
Third-party dependency trees, caches, binaries and build output
Complete source histories for other repositories; only README snapshots and links included
Unselected photo variants, third-party reference photos and duplicate files with identical SHA-256
scope: A personal knowledge and evidence package from identified local sources. Not a full disk, mailbox, Google Drive, or entire life-history backup.
